stage1.impression: A warm, convincingly moody night bar with good pools of light on the counter and a believable lens, but it reads as a competent CG visualisation, not a photograph: the bar top is a pale, smooth slab, the floor carries large hard elliptical shadow blotches that read as stains, the Dome pendants are blown white, and the frosted disc reads as a smudged face. The speakers are grey boxes in glaring white niches with no visible acrylic, tint or edge glow, so they are not the hero and the frame has no single colour accent. As it stands a magazine would see a generic, catalogue-like bar with a bookcase, not a specific place.

blocking_9: The back-bar speakers read at a glance as tinted cast acrylic (glowing polished edges, the white batts seen through the cabinet), lit as the brightest object in their niche, not silhouetted against a white glare
The counter top reads as zinc (darker, soft uneven metallic sheen, worn edge), not a pale concrete or plaster slab
No hard, stain-like shadow ellipses on the floor: the falloff of the downlights is soft and natural
Pendant domes hold tone and show the smoked tint, with no clipped shells
The frosted disc glows evenly instead of showing a blurred dark ring
Material detail at 1:1 (oak grain, books, zinc patina) without denoiser smear or grain
The frame has something specific to this place (the altar, the record players, the EARF products) legible enough that it could not be any bar

defects.what: White glare from the lit niche strip behind the left speaker's horn turns the horn into a black cut-out against a blown panel
Right niche is a bright grey-white box (median 107, clip 0.51 %); the speaker reads as a grey printed image, not acrylic
Dome pendant shell blown near-white (p95 250, clip 0.48 %), no smoked tint visible; same on the other three Domes
Counter top reads as pale smooth concrete or plaster, not zinc (median 129, p95 237, clip 0.26 %)
Floor shows large hard-edged dark ellipses (stool and chair shadows from narrow spots) that read as stains or a print pattern
Frosted disc reads as a smeared face or stain with a dark ring, not an even glow
Foreground tub chair is a crushed black mass (crush 27 %, median 10)
Altar speakers far back read as small grey monitors; two near-identical copies at the same scale, no tint, no light through acrylic
Book spines and shelves soft and smeared at 1:1 (denoiser), shelving tinted salmon-pink
Record player and glass objects on the counter are cluttered and illegible; R3 Float does not read

changes.problem: The lit niche strip blows out the back of the niches, so the speakers are silhouetted grey objects instead of glowing acrylic heroes.

evidence.measured: right niche median 107.5, p95 236, clip 0.51 %; left niche top [200,90,340,200] p95 225 behind a near-black horn

changes.expected: Niche back falls to a warm mid-dark; the cabinet and horn separate by their own light instead of by silhouette.

changes.problem: The speakers have no light of their own, so their tint and acrylic edges never read and they are not the hero.

evidence.measured: speaker region median 49 but neutral grey (R59 G47 B42 over the whole niche), no edge highlights seen at 1:1

change.setting: on each Ember speaker 4 x area (W/m2 at the target)
change.to: 3.0, aimed to graze the cabinet's polished edges

changes.expected: Cabinet faces lift to about 70 to 90, polished edges carry bright lines, the smoke tint and the batts behind it become legible.

changes.problem: The counter top reads as pale concrete, not zinc, and is the brightest large surface in the frame.

evidence.measured: median 129, p95 237, clip 0.26 %, smooth with no patina

change.setting: the zinc's patina, and the Domes' downlights
change.to: darker blue-grey zinc, metallic, roughness about 0.35 with uneven wipe marks and a worn front edge; downlights 90.0 W

changes.expected: Counter top reads as metal with pools under each Dome, median down to about 80 to 100, no clipping.

changes.problem: The Dome shells are blown white and show no smoked tint.
changes.expected: Shells hold a smoked tone with a brighter rim; only the opening at the bottom is bright.

changes.problem: Narrow hard spots throw stool and chair shadows as big hard ellipses that read as floor stains.

evidence.measured: median 72.6, range 107 with hard-edged dark ellipses seen in crop

change.setting: Domes' downlights cone and source size; floor polish
change.to: cone 30 deg with a 60 mm source radius and blend 0.5; floor polish slightly lower

changes.expected: Soft-edged shadows, a pool that falls off toward the walls, no pattern on the floor.

changes.problem: The frosted disc reads as a blurred face with a dark ring, not an evenly glowing frosted panel.

change.setting: the disc behind the DJ station (emission) and frosted acrylic roughness
change.to: 0.15 with the 4.0 W area lamp moved behind it; frosted roughness up so nothing behind it shows

changes.expected: A soft, even glow with a slightly brighter polished edge.

changes.problem: The foreground tub chair is a crushed black mass that occupies a large part of the lower frame.

change.from: coat on a counter chair; haze 0.004
change.to: drape the coat over the foreground tub chair's back so it catches the counter light; haze 0.006

changes.expected: The chair reads as leather with a highlight on its rim and a coat on it, a sign of life in the foreground.

changes.problem: Denoiser smear and grain flatten the oak, the books and the records at 1:1; the shelving reads salmon-pink.

evidence.measured: smeared spines in the crop; shelving R/B ratio about 1.5

changes.expected: Crisp grain and spines; oak reads brown, not pink.

out_of_scope.request: Give the speakers a visible tint so they carry the frame's one colour
out_of_scope.why: The Smoke configuration and the speakers' colour are fixed; in Smoke they read near-neutral grey, so the 'one colour' test can only be met by lighting the acrylic, or by shooting another configuration

out_of_scope.request: Make the altar pair differ from the back-bar pair, or crop one pair out, so four identical speakers do not read as repeated copies
out_of_scope.why: Four speakers are fixed by the room's design; only the camera could decide how many are in view

out_of_scope.request: Make the record player legible on the counter
out_of_scope.why: Its placement and the counter are fixed; only light and camera can help
